2026-05-22.description:
Frontera is reimagining how children with autism and other behavioral health needs get the care they deserve. We bring together world-class clinicians, technologists, and autism specialists to build cutting-edge AI tools that help care teams work smarter and spend more time with the children and families who need them most.
Our platform is HIPAA-compliant and designed for the real-world needs of behavioral health teams - from psychologists to ABA therapists. By combining evidence-based care with powerful technology, we’re expanding access to high-quality services for families everywhere.
Our Mission
Frontera exists to close the care gap: every child, no matter where they live, should be able to access effective behavioral healthcare.
Role Overview
As a
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
at Frontera, you’ll own the technical success of our most important clinic implementations and ongoing customer optimizations. You are both a builder and a technical owner in the field - responsible for making complex customer environments work seamlessly with the Frontera platform.
This is a highly technical, customer-facing role that sits at the intersection of engineering, product, and implementation. You’ll embed with key clinic partners during implementation and optimization phases, diagnosing gaps in configuration, data flow, integrations, and workflow design - and then directly building and shipping the solutions to resolve them.
Where traditional roles escalate or hand off, you execute. Where others identify problems, you own the full path to resolution.
You’ll become deeply fluent in how different clinic types operate, translating clinical and operational workflows (intake, scheduling, staffing, billing, reporting) into scalable technical implementations. Your work will directly shape both customer outcomes and the evolution of the core platform.
This is not a “solutions consulting” or coordination-heavy role. You will write production-grade code, build and maintain integrations, debug production issues in customer environments, and contribute to architectural decisions based on what you learn in the field.
Own Technical Outcomes Across Customer Implementations
Lead end-to-end technical execution for key clinic partners during implementation and post-launch optimization.
Translate complex clinical and operational workflows into scalable technical designs and implement them directly.
Build and maintain integrations across customer systems (EHRs, scheduling, billing, data pipelines), ensuring reliability and correctness in real-world usage.
Identify and resolve gaps between intended platform configuration and actual customer performance through hands-on engineering work.
Eliminate Friction and Accelerate Delivery
Act as the primary technical owner for complex customer issues that would otherwise require coordination across multiple internal teams.
Make fast, independent decisions on implementation approach by developing deep fluency in platform architecture and configuration patterns.
Build reusable technical patterns (integration templates, workflow modules, deployment playbooks) that improve speed and consistency across customers.
Shape the Forward Deployed Engineering Function
Help define the operating model for forward deployed engineering at Frontera, including tooling, standards, and deployment methodology.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure field learnings directly inform roadmap and platform design.
Contribute to scaling the function by documenting patterns and mentoring future forward deployed engineers as the team grows.
What You Bring
Experience
5–8+ years of experience
in software engineering, solutions engineering, or technical customer-facing roles with significant hands-on building responsibility.
Proven experience owning and delivering complex technical implementations end-to-end in production environments.
Strong background translating ambiguous operational workflows into concrete technical systems and integrations.
Experience working across APIs, data systems, and backend services without relying heavily on separate engineering teams.
Experience in healthcare, clinical, or highly operational domains is a strong plus.
Skills & Mindset
Strong bias toward execution and ownership—you move from problem to working solution quickly.
Solid engineering fundamentals paired with the ability to communicate clearly with clinical and operational stakeholders.
Systems thinker who can understand complex workflows and design durable technical solutions.
Comfortable operating as the primary technical interface in customer conversations and as the customer voice internally.
High accountability, low ego, and a focus on measurable customer outcomes.
AI Competency (Required)
Comfortable using modern AI tools to accelerate development, documentation, debugging, and customer delivery workflows.
Strong judgment around when AI-assisted outputs are sufficient and when human validation is required—especially in clinical or operational contexts.
Curiosity about applying AI to improve both internal engineering workflows and customer-facing systems.
Tools
Required
Proficiency in at least one backend language (Python strongly preferred)
Strong experience with REST APIs and system integrations
Working knowledge of SQL and structured data systems
Strong Plus
Experience with CRM or customer success platforms (HubSpot preferred)
Familiarity with EHR or practice management systems
Experience with workflow automation or integration platforms
Expected Salary Range in Denver:
$145,000 - $175,000
Expected Salary Range in San Francisco:
$170,000-$200,000
For remote candidates in other U.S. locations, compensation will be benchmarked to local market rates and adjusted based on experience and scope.
We have determined a salary range for this position that takes into account several factors including experience, knowledge, education, skills, and abilities. Please note that the salary information is a general guideline and the exact salary will be determined based on the individual’s qualifications and experience, with consideration given to the factors listed above.
All full-time employee benefits include a stake in shared success through stock options, health benefits, 401(k) plan, and 4 weeks of PTO per year.
Annual Salary
$145,000
-

USD
Why Frontera?
Opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation in pediatric healthcare.
Work on challenging and impactful projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies.
Collaborate with a talented and passionate team in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
Make a real difference in the lives of children and families in rural communities.
Competitive salary and benefits package.
Our Denver Office & Perks
Dog-friendly office.
Catered lunch from local Denver restaurants five days a week, plus occasional breakfasts and dinners.
Robust snack program and great coffee options (including cappuccino machine and cold brew cans).
Regular team events and low-key socials.
Up to $150/month commuter stipend, discounted nearby parking, and a discounted Colorado Athletic Club membership.
Thoughtfully designed space for focus, collaboration, and connection.
Competitive health benefits, stock options, 401(k), and generous PTO.
Join us in building the future of behavioral healthcare!

2026-05-22.description:
At Webflow, we’re building the world’s leading AI-native Digital Experience Platform, and we’re doing it as a remote-first company built on trust, transparency, and a whole lot of creativity. This work takes grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality. Our mission is to bring development superpowers to everyone. From entrepreneurs launching their first idea to global enterprises scaling their digital presence, we empower teams to design, launch, and optimize for the web without barriers. We believe the future of the web, and work, is more open, more creative, and more equitable. And we’re here to build it together.
We're looking for a
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
to prove what great agentic web operations look like in production—and turn those learnings into durable platform leverage.
You’ll operate at the intersection of Product, Sales, and Engineering—turning first-of-kind deployments into reusable patterns that shape Webflow’s platform roadmap.
Engagements are time-bound, and success is measured by how quickly solutions become reusable without ongoing FDE involvement.  If a solution only works for one customer, it’s not complete.
About the role:
Location: Remote-first (United States)
Full-time
Permanent
Exempt
The cash compensation for this role is tailored to align with the cost of labor in different geographic markets. We've structured the base pay ranges for this role into zones for our geographic markets, and the specific base pay within the range will be determined by the candidate’s geographic location, job-related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills.
United States (all figures cited below are in USD and pertain to workers in the United States)
Zone A: $158,300 - $190,000
Zone B: $148,300 - $178,000
Zone C: $140,000 - $168,000
This role is also eligible to participate in Webflow's company-wide bonus program. Target amounts are a percentage of base salary and vary by career level. Payouts are based on company performance against established financial and operational goals.
Please visit our
Careers page
for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.
Application Information:
Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled
This posting is for a new position
Reporting to the Director, Solutions Architects
As a
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
, you’ll …
Embed with strategic enterprise accounts to map business-critical workflows
Architect and implement agentic workflows using Webflow APIs, CMS, and AI capabilities
Build integrations across external platforms (analytics, CRM, DAM, data pipelines)
Design systems with observability, rollback, permissioning, and governance from day one
Ensure deployments are durable, scalable, and operate without ongoing FDE involvement
Identify where workflows break down and distinguish product gaps from customer-specific issues
Produce reusable architectures, reference implementations, and documented anti-patterns
Engage pre-sale to de-risk complex AI and integration use cases
About you:
Requirements
4–6 years in solutions engineering, forward deployment, or customer-facing engineering roles
Strong fluency in APIs, automation, data pipelines, and integration architectures
Experience building systems that operate on live web properties at scale
Solid front-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, modern frameworks)
Experience with workflow automation tools (e.g., n8n or similar)
Proven ability to operate in ambiguity and deliver in first-of-kind environments
Willingness to travel ~1x/month for embedded customer engagements
You’ll thrive as a
Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
if you:
Think in systems, not just features
Balance speed with production discipline
Know when to generalize vs. keep something bespoke
Can say no clearly when work doesn’t create leverage
Are energized by real-world constraints and production environments
Have experience with (or strong curiosity about) agentic AI and LLM-driven workflows
Are familiar with Webflow or similar CMS / visual development platforms
Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.
Our Core Behaviors:
Build lasting customer trust.
We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.
Win together.
We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.
Reinvent ourselves.
We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.
Deliver wi
th speed, quality, and craft.
We move fast because the moment demands it, and we do so without lowering the bar.
Benefits
Ownership in what you help build.
Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.
Health coverage that actually covers you.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.
Support for every stage of family life
. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.
Time off that’s actually off.
Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.
Wellness for the whole you.
Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.
Invest in your future.
A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.
Monthly stipends that flex with your life.
Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.
Bonus for building together.
All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.
Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.
Remote, together

committed
to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. About Arize
AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in.
Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform
, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize AX unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace—so teams can ship faster with confidence.
We’re a
Series C
company backed by top-tier investors,
with
over $135M in funding
and a rapidly growing customer base of
150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies.
Customers like
Booking.com
, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Forward Deployed AI Engineer to work directly with client engineering teams, manage multiple concurrent projects, and drive technical solutions that extend beyond our core platform offering. This is a client-facing, hands-on technical role that combines deep AI expertise with business acumen to deliver results on tight timelines while building lasting client relationships.
While we are a remote-first company, the nature of this role requires candidates to be based in the Singapore area.
What You’ll Do
Partner directly with enterprise AI teams to design, implement, and scale production-grade GenAI observability and evaluation programs.
Lead technical discussions with customer stakeholders ranging from engineers to senior executives, translating business priorities into scalable technical solutions.
Build custom integrations, tooling, and workflows that extend the Arize platform to meet customer-specific requirements.
Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements, driving projects from scoping through delivery while maintaining a high bar for technical execution and customer experience.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, CS, Product, and Engineering teams to shape implementation strategy, influence product direction, and expand customer impact.
Help define and scale best practices, technical playbooks, and delivery methodologies for the growing Forward Deployed Engineering team.
What We’re Looking For
Software Development:
2-5 years of hands-on software development experience with strong technical foundations. We work extensively in Python, Java, and TypeScript, and expect candidates to be comfortable working in at least two of those languages.
ML/AI Engineering:
Experience building MLOps pipelines and/or developing, deploying, and iterating on Generative AI applications in production environments..
Cloud Technologies
: Experience working with public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) as well as containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes).
Communication:
Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across both technical and business audiences. You should be comfortable engaging with senior executives on business outcomes and metrics, collaborating with engineers on technical implementation details, and translating seamlessly between the two.
Project Management:
Proven ability to manage multiple client engineering engagements simultaneously and deliver high-quality technical outcomes under demanding timelines.
Adaptability:
Comfortable operating in fast-paced startup or consulting environments, with the ability to navigate diverse client organizations, technical stacks, and evolving priorities.
Passion for AI:
We live and breathe AI at Arize. The strongest candidates are genuinely excited about the space and energized by staying at the forefront of rapidly evolving AI technologies.
Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.
More About Arize
Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.
Learn more about what we're doing here:
https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/20/arize-ai-hopes-it-has-first-mover-advantage-in-ai-observability/
https://arize.com/blog/arize-ai-raises-70m-series-c-to-build-the-gold-standard-for-ai-evaluation-observability/
Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize
Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture
Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup

2026-05-27.description:
At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
So, what's the role all about?
You'll architect and deliver production-ready conversational AI agents that sit at the core of the business and directly fuel company growth.
These are live, scalable agentic AI systems, not experiments or proof-of-concepts, operating across sectors like financial services, healthcare, and commerce.
You'll have full ownership of the entire AI agent lifecycle, steering projects from early pilot through launch and ongoing refinement.
You'll collaborate directly with decision-makers at the world’s leading enterprises to tackle their highest-priority challenges with agentic AI.
The patterns and problems you encounter in the field will feed directly into the evolution of the platform, tools, and product roadmap.
How will you make an impact?
Develop agentic systems (agents) for large-scale companies that measurably outperform human operators in areas like retention and churn reduction.
Build agents that handle nuanced, integrated customer interactions, across a range of CX transforming use cases.
Design reusable agent frameworks adapted to the specific demands of different industries.
Drive design partnerships around new product directions, including agent architectures, self-service features, and generative development workflows.
Push the boundaries with emerging voice models and pioneer their integration into enterprise-grade deployments.
Set the standard for how AI agents are constructed, evaluated, and improved in live production settings.
Have you got what it takes?
Hands-on experience building and operating end-to-end production systems at scale.
With a natural builder's mentality with high personal agency, you default to finding solutions and shipping them.
Startup founder or early engineer experience is highly valued, you understand the tradeoffs between speed, quality, and ownership.
Proven technical problem-solving ability, particularly in rapidly shifting, loosely defined environments.
Experience developing or operating AI/LLM-powered systems in production is a major plus.
Working knowledge of the current AI agent toolkit: evaluation frameworks, orchestration tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering.
Familiarity with React, TypeScript, and/or Go is an advantage.
At ease working face-to-face with customers to unpack their problems and deliver practical solutions.
Prior experience in customer-facing or externally-led technical roles is a plus.
A clear, direct communicator who can be equally persuasive with engineers and executives.
Comfortable operating in ambiguity and making forward progress without waiting for complete clarity.
Able to balance competing priorities and drive alignment across technical and business teams.
What's in it for you?
Build AI agents that run in production at meaningful scale, not slideware or research exercises.
Work shoulder-to-shoulder with leaders at globally recognized enterprises and high-growth startups.
Directly influence the direction of NiCE's AI agent platform through the real problems you solve.
Operate with genuine autonomy and end-to-end ownership across the agent lifecycle.
Work at the cutting edge of AI agent development with access to the latest models, infrastructure, and research.
Requisition ID: 10576
Reporting into:
Vice President, NiCE Agentic AI Transformation
Role Type:
Individual Contributor
About NiCE
NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions.
Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries.
NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.

AI Engineer, Provider & Oncology Innovation
Location: US Remote
The Role
This is a high-autonomy, high-agency position for a builder who thrives in ambiguity and wants to ship AI products that directly impact cancer care. You'll sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and design, working across all three modalities to ship products to customers. Your work will span two critical domains:
1. AI Products for Providers
Design and ship AI-powered experiences for oncologists and clinical teams. This includes exploring conversational AI experiences, building agent-based workflows that help providers navigate managing patient care, and bringing new clinical AI products to market. You'll spend meaningful time with customers to deeply understand their workflows and uncover where AI can create transformative value.
2. Commercializing Natera's AI Foundation Models
You'll be the bridge between Natera's AI research lab and the launched product. Our team has developed proprietary models that need to be brought to market and into the hands of clinicians. You'll contribute to training and post-training of these models, build the serving infrastructure, shape the user experience, and own the end-to-end deployments of these products.
What You'll Do
Ship zero-to-one AI products end-to-end
— from customer discovery and prototyping through production deployment and iteration
Build agentic AI systems
— design and implement autonomous and semi-autonomous workflows using LLMs, tool-use, memory, and orchestration
Develop AI tools
that improve efficiency across clinical operations, data extraction, manual workflows, and more
Commercialize AI research
— partner with the AI lab to take proprietary models from research prototypes and into production
Contribute to model training and post-training
— fine-tuning, evaluation, safety testing, and optimization of Natera's proprietary oncology models
What We're Looking For
Required
5+ years of software engineering experience
, with at least 2 years focused on AI/ML or LLM-powered products in production
Demonstrated ability to ship end-to-end
— you've taken AI features or products from idea to production, ideally in a zero-to-one context
Strong full-stack engineering skills
— proficiency in Python and modern web frameworks; you can build both the model pipeline and the user-facing product
Production experience with LLMs
— fine-tuning, RAG, prompt engineering, agentic architectures, structured extraction, evaluation, and observability
High agency and autonomy
— you don't wait for permission, detailed specs, or hand-holding. You unblock yourself, seek out the highest-impact work, and drive it to completion
Excellent communication
— you can translate complex AI concepts for clinical and business stakeholders, and articulate a vision for what you're building and why
Preferred
Experience in
healthcare, biotech, diagnostics, or pharma
— especially oncology
Familiarity with
clinical workflows
, electronic health records, or provider-facing software
Track record of working in
regulated environments
(HIPAA, FDA, CLIA, CAP)
Background in or comfort with
computational biology, genomics, or multimodal data
(imaging, sequencing, clinical records)
Experience with
AWS infrastructure
, Kubernetes, MLflow, or similar ML platform tooling
Prior experience in a
high-growth startup or zero-to-one product environment

2026-05-28.description:
About Arize
AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in.
Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform
, empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize AX unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace—so teams can ship faster with confidence.
We’re a
Series C
company backed by top-tier investors,
with
over $135M in funding
and a rapidly growing customer base of
150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies.
Customers like
Booking.com
, Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Forward Deployed AI Engineer to work directly with client engineering teams, manage multiple concurrent projects, and drive technical solutions that extend beyond our core platform offering. This is a client-facing, hands-on technical role that combines deep AI expertise with business acumen to deliver results on tight timelines while building lasting client relationships.
What You’ll Do
Partner directly with enterprise AI teams to design, implement, and scale production-grade GenAI observability and evaluation programs.
Lead technical discussions with customer stakeholders ranging from engineers to senior executives, translating business priorities into scalable technical solutions.
Build custom integrations, tooling, and workflows that extend the Arize platform to meet customer-specific requirements.
Manage multiple concurrent customer engagements, driving projects from scoping through delivery while maintaining a high bar for technical execution and customer experience.
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, CS, Product, and Engineering teams to shape implementation strategy, influence product direction, and expand customer impact.
Help define and scale best practices, technical playbooks, and delivery methodologies for the growing Forward Deployed Engineering team.
What We’re Looking For
Software Development:
2-5 years of hands-on software development experience with strong technical foundations. We work extensively in Python, Java, and TypeScript, and expect candidates to be comfortable working in at least two of those languages.
ML/AI Engineering:
Experience building MLOps pipelines and/or developing, deploying, and iterating on Generative AI applications in production environments..
Cloud Technologies
: Experience working with public cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) as well as containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker and Kubernetes).
Communication:
Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively across both technical and business audiences. You should be comfortable engaging with senior executives on business outcomes and metrics, collaborating with engineers on technical implementation details, and translating seamlessly between the two.
Project Management:
Proven ability to manage multiple client engineering engagements simultaneously and deliver high-quality technical outcomes under demanding timelines.
Adaptability:
Comfortable operating in fast-paced startup or consulting environments, with the ability to navigate diverse client organizations, technical stacks, and evolving priorities.
Passion for AI:
We live and breathe AI at Arize. The strongest candidates are genuinely excited about the space and energized by staying at the forefront of rapidly evolving AI technologies.
Actual compensation is determined based upon a variety of job related factors that may include: transferable work experience, skill sets, and qualifications. Total compensation also includes unlimited paid time off, generous parental leave plan, and others for mental and wellness support.
More About Arize
Arize’s mission is to make the world’s AI work—and work for people.
Our founders came together through a shared frustration: while investments in AI are growing rapidly across every industry, organizations face a critical challenge—understanding whether AI is performing and how to improve it at scale.
Learn more about what we're doing here:
https://techcrunch.com/2025/02/20/arize-ai-hopes-it-has-first-mover-advantage-in-ai-observability/
https://arize.com/blog/arize-ai-raises-70m-series-c-to-build-the-gold-standard-for-ai-evaluation-observability/
Diversity & Inclusion @ Arize
Our company's mission is to make AI work and make AI work for the people, we hope to make an impact in bias industry-wide and that's a big motivator for people who work here. We actively hope that individuals contribute to a good culture
Regularly have chats with industry experts, researchers, and ethicists across the ecosystem to advance the use of responsible AI
Culturally conscious events such as LGBTQ trivia during pride month
We have an active Lady Arizers subgroup
